profile.name: Rammohan Murmu
profile.title: Creative Graphics & Web Designer | Video Editor
profile.tagline: Transforming ideas into high-impact visuals, modern 3D web experiences & cinematic videos.
profile.shortBio: Specializing in High-End Branding, UI/UX Design, Modern Web Development, and Viral Video Editing with over 3+ years of experience.
profile.fullBio: Hello! I am Rammohan Murmu, a passionate multidisciplinary designer and creative video editor based in India. I craft distinctive visual identities, intuitive user experiences, responsive modern websites, and engaging motion content. My mission is to elevate brands and creators through cutting-edge 3D aesthetics, bold typography, seamless animations, and strategic design.

services.title: Graphics Designing
services.shortDesc: Crafting premium visual brand identities, advertising creatives, high-conversion YouTube thumbnails, event posters, certificates, and flex banners.

services.title: UI/UX & Web Design
services.shortDesc: Designing user-centric mobile applications, SaaS dashboards, and modern interactive 3D web interfaces with Figma wireframes and responsive prototypes.

services.title: Cinematic Video Editing
services.shortDesc: High-retention YouTube video editing, cinematic color grading, teaser trailers, commercial promo ads, TikTok/Reels viral shorts, and custom sound design.

projects.title: CyberForge Gaming - Viral YouTube Thumbnails Suite
projects.description: High-CTR 3D gaming thumbnail package featuring custom 3D lighting, expression cutouts, dynamic glow strokes, and vibrant visual hierarchy that improved click-through rates by 28%.

reviews.comment: Rammohan's thumbnail designs skyrocketed our video CTR from 6.2% to 11.4%! Absolutely phenomenal work.

projects.title: Apex Esports - Brand Identity & Logo Suite
projects.description: Complete visual identity design including an aggressive vector mascot logo, brand guidelines manual, typography palette, jersey graphics, and stream overlay assets.

reviews.comment: Transformed our whole gaming organization identity. The vector precision is unbelievable.

projects.title: Sunburn Music Festival - Grand Event Poster & Flex Banner
projects.description: High-resolution multi-format event promotional campaign including A3 printed posters, highway flex hoardings (20x10 ft), and social media announcement carousels.

projects.title: Global Tech Academy - Premium Certificate & Smart ID Card
projects.description: Official security-enhanced diploma certificate with guilloche watermark borders and QR verification, paired with modern NFC-ready corporate employee ID cards.

projects.title: HyperX Gear Launch - 4K Cinematic Commercial & Teaser Trailer
projects.description: High-octane commercial teaser trailer featuring 3D product motion graphics, dynamic sound design with heavy bass hits, cinematic anamorphic color grading, and VFX glitches.

reviews.comment: The trailer got 300k+ views on launch week! Sound design and pacing were top notch.

projects.title: Alex Vlogs - High Retention Viral YouTube Editing
projects.description: Fast-paced YouTube editing style with custom sound effects, animated subtitle captions, B-roll transitions, zooms, and custom thumbnails that increased average watch duration by 42%.

projects.title: NovaPay - Crypto & Neo-Banking Mobile App UI/UX
projects.description: Next-gen fintech mobile app featuring dark/glassmorphic aesthetics, biometric authentication, instant crypto swap interfaces, and fully interactive Figma component design systems.

projects.title: Quantum SaaS - 3D Analytics Dashboard & Web Landing Page
projects.description: Futuristic dark-mode landing page and analytics dashboard with interactive 3D particle canvas background, real-time KPI graphs, and smooth scroll animations.
